descriptions.text: FSL project is suspected of being a Rug Pull, with a loss of approximately $1.68 million. FSL token plummeted 99.8%.

BNB Chain FSL rug pull on 2023-10-10. A reported launch mint fed a wallet that sold 97,000,000 FSL for 1,680,644.758751 USDT, then moved BNB through Tornado Cash. The creator retained mint authority over FSL, expanded supply at launch, and a wallet holding that supply sold 97,000,000 FSL for 1,680,644.758751 USDT before moving BNB into Tornado Cash. The exact historical mint implementation has not been recovered, so the privileged function remains unverified.
